title: Our School Needs a Reading Garden
passage_text:
Our school should build a reading garden by the library. Right now, the space by the library is an empty patch of dirt. I think a garden would be the best place in the whole school.

The library has more than two thousand books. Students could carry those books outside and read under a tree. Plants need sunlight and water to grow. The patch gets sun every morning, and there is a water hose nearby.

Reading outside is more fun than reading inside. A garden would also be beautiful to look at. Please vote yes for the reading garden at our next class meeting!

skill_instances.quote: Right now, the space by the library is an empty patch of dirt.
skill_instances.explanation: Fact: you can go look and check it.

skill_instances.quote: I think a garden would be the best place in the whole school.
skill_instances.explanation: Opinion: I think shows what the writer feels.

skill_instances.quote: The library has more than two thousand books.
skill_instances.explanation: Fact: someone could count the books.

skill_instances.quote: The patch gets sun every morning, and there is a water hose nearby.
Reading outside is more fun than reading inside.
skill_instances.explanation: Opinion: other people might feel differently.

lesson_hooks.hook_question: What would make your school a better place?
lesson_hooks.i_do: Model one fact and one opinion from paragraph one.
lesson_hooks.we_do: Is 'The library has more than two thousand books' a fact or an opinion?
lesson_hooks.you_do_question: Find one opinion in the last paragraph.
